get.summary: Case-insensitive regex over the service-arb playbook.
get.description:
Each kind of source has its own slots, so none crowds out another: the manual (knowledge/structured), the course (lessons and the recordings they link), calls, videos, texts. Within a kind, a passage holding the rarer of the pattern's alternatives ranks first. Each hit gives path:line, its header, its label, the source URL and the lines around it; the files past the slots follow as path:line, for `read`. A pattern hitting most of the scope is refused, with the sub-scopes it hits.

A label is who backs the passage, how they know (ran it, says so, heard it), how sure they were in σ, the information's age, `init`: what it was worth when said, and `norm`: what it is worth today, 0 to 1, higher is better. `unvetted`: nobody of ours has checked the claim. `unscored`: nothing says who speaks.

sites.OpeningHours.description: A row of opening hours, in the place's local time (Europe/Paris for every place in v1).

closes.description: After `opens`: a night across midnight is two rows.

days.description: One at least, each once, in week order.

sites.Paid.description: What a slice's leads were paid in one currency, in its minor units; never converted.

sites.Place.description: A place: its live settings, who set them last, and where it stands.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may change it.

gmb_id.description: The conductor's GMB this place is the landing of.

settings.description: Only the fields set; `{}` when none (the site serves its baked config).

updated_at.description: Null while the settings were never set: what a first edit must expect.

withdrawn.description: Off the sites: they answer it as gone.

sites.PlaceChange.description: One change of a place: its settings before and after.

by.description: The user's email, else their id; `cli` from the pod.

reverts.description: The change a revert went back before.

sites.PlaceChangeKind.description:
What a change did to a place.

- `register`: Registered by hand (it may not have had a lead yet).
- `set`: Its settings replaced.
- `revert`: The settings an earlier change found, put back.
- `withdraw`: Taken off the sites: they answer it as gone.
- `restore`: Back on the sites.

sites.PlaceLive.description:
A place's live settings: only the fields that are set. Empty: the site serves its baked
config.

landmark.description: A text per locale; a site keeps it only when every locale it speaks is there.

messengers.description: The landing's messenger buttons switched off where `false`; a messenger left out is on.

reviewUrl.description: Where the place asks for a Google review.

telegram.description: The place's Telegram bot: its username, without the `@`.

changed_at.description: Its latest change: registered, set, reverted, withdrawn or restored; null for a place only leads name.

has_settings.description: Live settings with a field set at least.

cents.description: Integer cents EUR TTC; null when the need is a quote.

locales.description: The languages every label must be in; fr and en unless set.

model.description: Null when never set or removed: the sites keep their baked one.

updated_at.description: Null while never set: what a first save must expect. A removal has a time too.

sites.PricingChange.description: One change of a brand's pricing.

changed.description:
What it changed of the model before it, in the model's order; null for a first save or
when either side is a removal.

model.description: The model the change left; null for a removal.

needs.description: How many needs the saved model prices; null for a removal.

valid_from.description: The saved model's `validFrom`; null for a removal.

sites.PricingInput.description:
An enum the visitor answers: bedrooms, a surface band, a zone, a frequency. Its kind says
what its options do, and when: every `add` first, then every `multiply`, then every
`discount`.

sites.PricingModel.description:
A checked model, in its wire shape: every value within the limits, which keeps a price
within an `i64` and a double alike. Only [`PricingModel::parse`] makes one.

minimumCents.description: An estimate never comes out below this, after the rounding.

needs.description: By the brand's need slug; a need not here is a quote.

roundToCents.description: The estimate's total is rounded half up to a multiple of this (1 = to the cent).

validFrom.description:
`YYYY-MM-DD`, a day the calendar has: when the prices hold from. Stored with every lead
priced by it.

sites.Provider.description:
Where a slot is booked.

- `manual`: No external page: the site promises a call, and an operator records the slot.
- `link`: An external booking page on any https host; no adapter reads it back.
- `google_calendar`: A Google Calendar appointment schedule; its bookings are pulled from the calendar.
- `cal_com`: Cal.com, ours (`cal.evinvest.ltd`) or the hosted cloud.

sites.ProviderBooking.description: A provider's booking as the front end reads it.

contact.description: The attendee, for a caller who sees PII.

lead_id.description: The lead it joined; null while unmatched.

sites.Rating.description:
Google's rating for the place, with when it was read: the API's terms cap how long a copy
may be shown.

expected_updated_at.description:
Required: taking a brand's prices off its sites over a version the editor did not see is
not something to do by default. Null for pricing never set.
Checked as a PUT checks it: null for settings never set. Absent: over whatever is there.

locales.description: 1 to 8, each once: every label of the brand's model must be in each.

expected_updated_at.description: The `updated_at` the editor read; null (or absent) for settings never set.

settings.description: The whole of the settings, not a patch: a field left out is cleared.

expected_updated_at.description: The `updated_at` the editor read; null (or absent) for pricing never set.

sites.Share.description:
A share as the front end may show it: `percent` only when `of` is large enough, and
`small_sample` saying so otherwise, so "12 of 17" is all that can be drawn.

sites.Sla.description: A lead's wait for its first contact: overdue after 30 minutes.

sites.Stage.description:
The personal stages, in funnel order. `Lost` is off to the side: any stage can end
there, and any later progress takes the lead out of it again.

sites.StageMove.description: Where a lead moves, and what the move says.

sites.Status.description: Where an event stands with the registry.

sites.SuspectFilter.description:
Which of the suspect leads to list.

- `only`: Only those the landing's antispam doubted.
- `exclude`: None of them.

assistant.description: Where the assistant is shown; without it, as this browser last left it.

find.description: What the outline's list is filtered by.

gmbs.description: The GBPs selected; empty, being picked.

access.description: Asking for a permission the caller lacks, then on to where they were going.

account.description: The caller's account: their sign-in, their Claude, what they spend.

alerts.description: Where the caller's alerts go, and which.

area.description: The review kit on the operator's phone: an area's GBPs and their QRs.

home.description: The map of the caller's GBPs, and every window over it.

account.description: The gmail whose window is open.

add.description: The Add a GBP panel, with what it starts from.

area.description: The area a study is framed by; empty, one being drawn.

at.description: Where the map looks: latitude, longitude, zoom.

brand.description: The brand whose page is open, under `trade` · `country`.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, of the countries GBPs are in.

gmb.description: The GBP whose window is open.

kit.description: The review kit's area: empty, one being drawn.

pressure.description: The pressure field, at this radius in metres.

schematic.description: The schematic base map, not the satellite.

study.description: The study drawn: `<trade id>.<country>`; empty, none picked whatever the scope.

tiers.description: Tiers whose weight or visibility was moved off the study's own.

trade.description: The trade whose window is open, on `country`'s tab.

members.description: Everyone, to act as; and the way back while acting.

sites.description: sites' pages, its element's to route.

sources.description: Source keys and the sites they connect.

tokens.description: The caller's tokens: balance, ledger, what they used.
